# FHIR R4 Patient Search by Medical Record Number

In FHIR R4, you search for a Patient by medical record number using the **`identifier`** search parameter via the REST API.

## Basic Syntax

```
GET [base]/Patient?identifier=[system]|[value]
```

## Example

```
GET http://example.com/fhir/Patient?identifier=http://hospital.example.com/mrn|12345
```

## Breaking Down the Components

- **`[system]`**: The URI that defines the coding system for the identifier (e.g., your hospital's MRN system)
- **`[value]`**: The actual medical record number value
- **`|`**: Separator between system and value

## Practical Example

If your hospital uses the system `urn:oid:1.2.840.113619.6.21`, you would search as:

```
GET /Patient?identifier=urn:oid:1.2.840.113619.6.21|MRN789456
```

## Optional Modifiers

You can also use modifiers for more specific searches:

```
GET /Patient?identifier=MRN789456          # Search by value only (less specific)
GET /Patient?identifier:exact=[value]      # Exact match
GET /Patient?identifier:of-type=[system]|[value]  # Specify type as well
```

## Response

The server returns a FHIR Bundle containing Patient resources matching the criteria.
